_README: Example config for scripts/build_branded_docx.py — copy to
scripts/branded_docx.config.json (git-ignored) and edit, or point at it
must match the EXACT placeholder text inside your reference .docx (the one
you pass via --template / BRANDED_TEMPLATE). Cover/header/footer needles are
spliced into raw document XML, so a value may contain literal XML (e.g.
metadata below (XML-escaped in the XML maps, raw in the table rows).
Leave a map as {} to skip that surgery. Metadata also accepts DOC_TITLE /
DOC_SUBTITLE / DOC_DATE / DOC_AUTHOR / DOC_SUBJECT / DOC_KEYWORDS env overrides.
